nodes.description: Public address storing the address of the most recent lottery winner; set inside RandomWinner from a randomly indexed player.
Public address of the contract owner, initialised to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the privileged caller of UpdateNumPlayers.
Public uint256 accumulating msg.value from every entry payment; reset to zero after a winner is paid.
Public uint256 threshold of players; set to 10 in the constructor and mutable by the owner through UpdateNumPlayers.
Public uint256 counter incremented at the end of each RandomWinner round.
Public dynamic address array of current participants; pushed on each payable fallback call and deleted after a payout.
Contract constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender and initialises MaxPlayers = 10 (initialisation / access-control surface).
Owner-only setter that changes the MaxPlayers threshold after checking owner != msg.sender and 3 <= num < 1000.
Payable fallback function: validates msg.value >= .01 ether, records msg.sender as a player, grows the jackpot and triggers RandomWinner at capacity.
Public view returning the players array.
Private view pseudo-random generator hashing block.difficulty, now, msg.sender and the players array — predictable randomness source.
Private payout routine: computes a fee, selects lastWinner, performs two external transfers, then resets players/jackpot and increments completedGames.
Library multiplication with overflow assertion (assert(c / _a == _b)).
Library unsigned division used to compute the winner fee.
Library subtraction with underflow assertion (assert(_b <= _a)).
Library addition with overflow assertion (assert(c >= _a)).
Caller-controlled address used as owner, as a player entry, as a randomness seed and implicitly as transfer recipient.
Block timestamp (now) fed into the randomness hash, giving miner-influenceable randomness / timestamp dependency.
Parameter of UpdateNumPlayers carrying the new MaxPlayers value supplied by the owner.
First operand of SafeMath.mul.
Second operand of SafeMath.mul.
Numerator of SafeMath.div.
Denominator of SafeMath.div.
Minuend of SafeMath.sub.
Subtrahend of SafeMath.sub.
First addend of SafeMath.add.
Second addend of SafeMath.add.
Local result of SafeMath.mul.
Local result of SafeMath.add.
Local payout fee computed as balance/100 in RandomWinner and sent to the owner.
External value transfer lastWinner.transfer(address(this).balance - fee) executed before internal state is reset — reentrancy sink.
External value transfer owner.transfer(fee) executed before players/jackpot are cleared — reentrancy sink.
Pseudo-random selection based on block.difficulty, now, msg.sender and the players array, which is miner-influenceable and publicly predictable.
Access-control comparison owner != msg.sender guarding the UpdateNumPlayers state mutation.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the caller-controlled msg.sender as owner, making ownership dependent on untrusted input.
Constructor writes the owner state variable.
Constructor initialises MaxPlayers to 10.
msg.sender is compared against owner inside the access-control guard.
The owner state variable is the privileged side of the owner != msg.sender check.
Owner-supplied parameter num flows into the privileged MaxPlayers state variable.
UpdateNumPlayers performs the privileged write to MaxPlayers.
The owner/range guard gates whether MaxPlayers is updated.
Caller-controlled msg.sender is pushed into the players array on every payable call.
Fallback function mutates the players array (players.push).
Fallback performs jackpot += msg.value, an unchecked accumulator update.
Fallback invokes RandomWinner once players.length >= MaxPlayers.
block.timestamp (now) is hashed into the randomness value — timestamp dependency.
msg.sender is hashed into the randomness value, allowing caller influence over the draw.
The players array is hashed into the randomness seed.
random() feeds the weak randomness operation derived from miner-controllable block data.
The random index modulo players.length selects the new lastWinner.
RandomWinner assigns players[random() % players.length] to lastWinner.
RandomWinner is the only writer of the lastWinner state variable.
lastWinner (a player-controlled address) is the target of the external value transfer.
The external transfer to lastWinner can re-enter RandomWinner, whose state resets happen afterwards.
owner is the destination of the fee transfer, an external call made before state cleanup.
The external fee transfer to owner can re-enter RandomWinner.
RandomWinner deletes the players array only after the external transfers (state change after call).
RandomWinner resets jackpot = 0 only after the external transfers (state change after call).
RandomWinner increments completedGames at the end of the round.
RandomWinner calls SafeMath.div to compute the fee.
The SafeMath.div result is stored in the fee local variable.
Computed fee flows into the external owner.transfer call.
Computed fee is subtracted from the balance sent to lastWinner.
First mul operand participates in the multiplication result.
Second mul operand participates in the multiplication result.
SafeMath.mul returns the local c used for the overflow assertion.
First add operand participates in the addition result.
Second add operand participates in the addition result.
SafeMath.add returns the local c used for the overflow assertion.
Numerator input of SafeMath.div.
Denominator input of SafeMath.div.
Minuend input of SafeMath.sub, asserted against underflow.
Subtrahend input of SafeMath.sub.
getPlayers returns (reads) the players state array.
RandomWinner executes the external transfer to lastWinner before clearing state.
RandomWinner executes the external fee transfer to owner before clearing state.
